title: Relative tensor functors on internal modules have right adjoints
statement: Let C be a locally v-small Grothendieck abelian category with an additive closed symmetric monoidal structure, and R a commutative monoid object of C. Let Mod(C,R) be the category of left internal R-modules, with its relative tensor product defined as the coequalizer of the two R-actions. For every M in Mod(C,R), the functor M tensor_R (-) has a right adjoint. Consequently Mod(C,R) is monoidal closed.

proof.text: Recover additivity of the ambient tensor from closedness: both tensor functors are left adjoints, preserve finite coproducts and zero morphisms, and hence are additive. This avoids adding a MonoidalPreadditive parameter absent from the original elaborated monoidalClosed signature. The existing Mod.isGrothendieckAbelian now supplies the Grothendieck structure on modules.

For a fixed module M, put F0 = forget R followed by ambient tensorRight R and ambient tensorRight M.X, and F1 = forget R followed by ambient tensorRight M.X. The two natural transformations F0 to F1 act on N by rightAct N tensor M.X and by the associator followed by N.X tensor act M.X. Naturality follows from linearity, braiding naturality, and associator naturality. Form their parallel-pair diagram D in the functor category.

The ambient tensor functors and forget R preserve small colimits. Pointwise evaluation therefore shows D.flip preserves colimits, and so does D.flip followed by colim. The coequalizer isomorphism induced by diagramIsoParallelPair and isColimitTensorPi identifies this functor naturally with monoidal tensorRight M followed by forget R. For naturality, cancel the colimit inclusions and use tensorObjPi_whiskerRight; at the source of the parallel pair also use naturality of its first arrow. This is the same coequalizer comparison used by the separately bundled module-tensor proof, constructed directly in the ambient category.

Reflect preservation of colimits along forget R, then use the descended symmetry to obtain preservation for monoidal tensorLeft M. The module category is Grothendieck abelian, so the special adjoint functor theorem isLeftAdjoint_of_preservesColimits_of_isSeparating applies to its separator. Functor.rightAdjoint and Adjunction.ofIsLeftAdjoint package the resulting uniquely specified adjoint into Closed M and hence MonoidalClosed. All data are determined up to the usual adjunction isomorphism; no arbitrary object is selected from an unproved existence statement.
